description.p: Pervius is a GTK 4/libadwaita desktop client for an existing FastVPN (OpenVPN) subscription. It downloads the provider's public server catalogue, validates every profile strictly, and imports the selected profile through NetworkManager and its OpenVPN plugin.

The application runs as an ordinary user. NetworkManager performs the privileged network operations, and passwords are supplied by a NetworkManager secret agent instead of being written into the VPN profile. An optional kill switch, backed by a small system service and polkit, blocks traffic outside the tunnel while it is armed.

It offers country search with flags, favorites, bounded automatic reconnection, a tray icon, desktop notifications, and connection details such as the VPN exit IP and traffic totals. It manages one NetworkManager profile and does not provide auto-protect or DNS filtering.
Pervius is an independent open-source project by Solvetus Labs. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Namecheap, Inc. FastVPN is a trademark of Namecheap, Inc.

First public release under the name Pervius, licensed under the Apache License 2.0. Settings, favorites, a saved password and the managed NetworkManager profile from earlier test builds are adopted automatically on first start.
